summary: The configured-provider attempt failed before a structured response and consumed one invocation. The application stopped immediately as designed. Repair dotted configuration overrides and preserve bounded redacted startup diagnostics so another failure can be diagnosed from durable evidence.
findings: The first failed route consumed six calls; the second attempt consumed one. Seven total reservations remain recorded without refunds.
Quoted provider names in dotted CLI override paths may be interpreted as literal key segments. Use validated bare provider identifiers; preserve TOML quoting only for values.
Retain a redacted tail of stderr in failed-call records. The original attempt's generic error was insufficient diagnostic evidence.
This repair is a tested configuration-shape change; live startup remains to be validated and is not predeclared successful.
